item.title: Tanzid makes history as Bangladesh dominate first Australia Test
item.description: Tanzid Hasan hits first Bangladesh ton in Australia as tourists close Day Two of first Test on 351-6, leading by 153.

item.title: US accuses dozens of countries of helping China avoid Trump’s tariffs
item.description: White House report claims tens of billions of dollars in annual revenue lost to transshipments.

item.title: South Korea players want K League season change due to ‘worsening climate’
item.description: South Korea football players push for a K League season shift as 'punishing heat' hitting summer matches.

item.title: Wildfires force thousands to flee as blazes spread across Europe
item.description: At least a dozen people have reportedly been hospitalised in Croatia after blazes tore into the tourist town of Omis.

item.title: Engine debris shattered Ryanair window, pulling passenger out, NTSB says
item.description: Flight crews had recorded four suspected bird strikes involving the same engine during the previous year.

item.title: The Gambian women turning grief into song
item.description: Known as the Kanyeleng, they have transformed their experience of child loss through a tradition of music.

item.title: Stolen Matisse art found in Brazil
item.description: Stolen Matisse art found in Brazil

item.title: South Africa end Nigeria’s Women’s World Cup hope, Ghana beat Ivory Coast
item.description: South Africa and Ghana claim Africa's two FIFA Intercontinental Playoff spots as Nigeria and Ivory Coast go out.

item.title: Prichard Colon dies from boxing injury that resulted in 221-day coma
item.description: Prichard Colon suffered neurological damage that required emergency surgery following a boxing bout in 2015.

item.title: Nigel Farage defeats Count Binface to reclaim UK parliamentary seat
item.description: The Reform UK leader received 22,239 votes in the Clacton by-election, compared with 9,455 for Binface.

item.title: Flock adds safeguards to licence-plate readers after wave of stalking cases
item.description: US firm tightens oversight of automatic licence-plate readers after reports of misuse by police officers.

item.title: North Korea fumes over upcoming US-South Korea military drills
item.description: Pyongyang has accused the US of pushing the world 'to the brink of nuclear war'.

item.title: Fear and attacks grip Taybeh, the last all-Christian town in the West Bank
item.description: Historic Taybeh, a Palestinian Christian town in the occupied West Bank, targeted by settlers in coordinated attacks.

item.description: Record rainfall in Chiba claims lives as more than 22,000 households without power on busy Bon Buddhist holiday week.

item.title: Salvage work begins on tanker leaking oil off Oman, risk firm says
item.description: Environmental NGO Greenpeace warns that spill has rapidly expanded to 1,300 square kilometres, threatening ecosystems.

item.title: How much power does the US hold in Venezuela?
item.description: After Maduro’s removal, US influence in Venezuela soared, but experts say Washington may still have to ‘own’ Venezuela.

item.title: Al Jazeera speaks to Count Binface as Farage claims Clacton victory
item.description: Al Jazeera’s Jonah Hull spoke to candidate for MP, Count Binface, as votes were counted in Clacton.

item.title: Water supply for three US states drips down, Lake Mead at record low
item.description: The largest reservoir in the United States, located on the border of Arizona and Nevada, just hit a record low.

item.title: Brazil begins exploring retaliatory options to new US tariffs
item.description: Brazil has not yet decided whether it will proceed with retaliatory measures, but commits to defending its position.

item.title: Mali says 82 soldiers captured by armed groups have been freed
item.description: Malian army says the soldiers were held prisoner by Tuareg and al-Qaeda-linked armed groups in the northern region.

item.description: An oil slick from the tanker the Caroline Bezengi has reached Oman’s coastline weeks after the vessel ran aground.

item.title: Why Osun’s election matters for Nigeria’s 2027 vote
item.description: The result could offer an early signal of shifting alliances and voter sentiment before the presidential race.

item.title: UN, Palestinian ministry condemn Israeli settler siege of West Bank homes
item.description: UN rights office and Palestine Foreign Ministry call days-long Israeli settler siege in Qusra 'criminal' and 'inhumane'.

item.title: Could Trump actually run for a third term as president?
item.description: Donald Trump says the law stopping him from seeking a third presidential term is ‘very strong’.

item.title: Bodycam captures lightning striking metres from US police officers
item.description: Bodycam video captured the moment lightning struck just metres from South Dakota Highway Patrol officers.
